en: The front side of the postcard shows a rustic stone building with a tiled roof partially obscured by trees and bushes. The view is framed by a large white archway, and some old millstones are visible on the ground, adding to the traditional atmosphere. The back side has text in multiple languages (Bulgarian, French, German, English) identifying the subject as the restaurant 'Vodenitzata' in Varna, Bulgaria, specifically at 'Golden Sands' (Sables d'Or), a well-known seaside resort. There are lines for an address, a spot for a stamp, and a large handwritten number '76'.
